statements.t: The Company expects to recognize transaction costs of approximately $7 million to $8 million in the fourth quarter of 2026.

The Company expects noninterest expenses in the fourth quarter of 2026 to increase from the third quarter of 2026, reflecting normal operating growth, as well as the transaction costs of approximately $7 million to $8 million related to the loan sale described above under “Balance Sheet Restructuring and Repositioning.”
The Company has incorporated the anticipated 2026 tax credits and net benefits from this investment into its estimated annual effective tax rate for 2026.
The Company expects the underlying projects to be placed in service in tranches during the fourth quarter of 2026.

The methodology for determining the ACL is considered a critical accounting policy by management because of the high degree of judgment involved, the subjectivity of the assumptions used, and the potential for changes in the forecasted economic environment that could result in changes to the amount of the recorded ACL.
In management’s view, the level of the ACL as of September 30, 2026 is adequate to cover expected credit losses over the contractual term of the loan portfolio.

Management seeks to identify deteriorating credits early and to recognize charge-offs on a timely basis, based on assessments of expected cash flows and the value of underlying collateral, while maintaining an adequate ACL.
Loans may be placed on nonaccrual status earlier when management determines that collection of all principal and interest is not expected.

Unrealized losses have not been recognized into income because the issuers are of high credit quality, we do not intend to sell, and it is likely that we will not be required to sell the securities prior to their anticipated recovery.
We seek to reduce the vulnerability of our operations to changes in interest rates, and actions in this regard are taken under the guidance of the Bank’s Asset Liability Committee (the “ALCO”).

The models assume that the composition of the Company’s interest sensitive assets and liabilities existing at the beginning of a period remain constant over the period being measured, thus they do not consider the Company’s strategic plans, or any other steps it may take to respond to changes in rates over the forecasted period of time.
Given the nature and speed with which interest rates change, the projections noted above on the Company’s EVE and net interest income can be expected to differ from actual results.

estimates.t: Our accounting policies are integral to understanding the results reported.

estimates.name: Balance Sheet Restructuring and Repositioning
estimates.t: During the third quarter of 2026, the Company completed a strategic review of its balance sheet and identified a pool of non-relationship multifamily loans to be sold with an unpaid principal balance of $753.7 million.

estimates.name: Operating Results Overview
estimates.t: Net income available to common stockholders for the three months ended September 30, 2026 was $29.9 million, compared to $39.5 million for the prior-year period.
estimates.effect: This was partially offset by a $15.3 million increase in net interest income, a $5.2 million decrease in income tax expense, a $3.3 million decrease in noninterest expenses and a $0.5 million decrease in the provision for credit losses.

estimates.name: Net Interest Income and Margin
estimates.t: Net interest income is the difference between the interest earned on the portfolio of earning assets (principally loans and investments) and the interest paid on deposits and borrowings, which support these assets.

estimates.name: Average Statements of Condition with Interest and Average Rates — Noninterest Income
estimates.t: Noninterest income was a net loss of $14.5 million for the three months ended September 30, 2026, compared with income of $19.4 million for the prior-year period.
estimates.effect: These were partially offset by a $1.2 million increase in BOLI income, driven by death benefits recorded in the third quarter of 2026, and a $0.3 million increase in net gains on sale of loans held-for-sale, primarily SBA loans.

estimates.name: Noninterest Expenses
estimates.t: Noninterest expenses totaled $55.4 million for the three months ended September 30, 2026, compared with $58.7 million for the prior-year period.
estimates.effect: Noninterest expenses totaled $55.4 million for the three months ended September 30, 2026, compared with $58.7 million for the prior-year period.

estimates.name: Income Taxes
estimates.t: Income tax expense for the prior-year period included a $3.0 million estimated state tax liability resulting from intercompany dividends.
estimates.effect: Income tax expense was $11.0 million for the three months ended September 30, 2026, compared with $16.3 million for the prior-year period.
